summary.text: Brian Chisholm is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 31, in Anne Arundel County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former mortgage banker, he has served in the House since January 2019 and is an Assistant Minority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Chisholm was born in Madison, Wisconsin, graduated from Severna Park High School in 1989, and earned a B.A. in marketing from Clemson University in 1994.

He worked as a mortgage banker at 1st Mariner Bank from 2010 to 2014 and as a senior mortgage banker at Capital Bank of Maryland from 2014 to 2022, and has owned and operated Rockwell Fitness since 2018.
Chisholm served on the Anne Arundel County Pension Oversight Commission from 2015 to 2018, and was first elected to the House of Delegates in 2018.

He has been an Assistant Minority Whip since 2021 and in 2026 sits on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee; he previously served on the Health and Government Operations Committee from 2019 to 2025.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described his campaign as focused on affordability, public safety, government accountability and energy costs, and said he is passionate about energy, transparency and accountability.
